name: Caged in Chaos — Victoria Biggs
description: Lived-experience and practical book written from a dyspraxic young person's perspective, covering school, organisation, social experience and everyday life.
intended_use: Inspect a dyspraxic/DCD lived-experience perspective beyond the catalogue's autism and ADHD material.
audience_or_context: International / not jurisdiction-specific; teenagers, young adults, families and supporters interested in dyspraxia/DCD lived experience.
limitations: One author's account cannot represent every person with DCD/dyspraxia.
Practical suggestions in a memoir/guide are not clinical treatment recommendations.
cost_or_access_notes: Commercial book; edition, format, library and retailer availability vary.
conflicts_of_interest: The author and publisher have a commercial interest in the book.
